hero.title: Video to GIF
hero.tagline: Convert any video clip to an animated GIF — free, instant, and private.

whatIs.heading: What is Video to GIF?
whatIs.body: This tool extracts frames from a video clip and encodes them as an animated GIF — entirely inside your browser. No data is uploaded to any server.

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.body: Your video file never leaves your device. All processing happens locally using browser APIs.

limitations.heading: Limitations
limitations.body: GIFs support a maximum of 256 colors per frame, so they are best suited for short clips (under 15 seconds). Large or high-frame-count conversions may take a moment to process.

howItWorks.step1: Drop or browse for a video file (MP4, WebM, MOV, AVI).
howItWorks.step2: Set the clip range using Start Time and End Time.
howItWorks.step3: Choose FPS and output width, then click Convert to GIF.
howItWorks.step4: Preview the result and click Download to save your GIF.

controls.largeWarning: this may take a while and produce a large file
